title: test_proof_coverage.py's three reds on the house checkout: the corpus tooth is a host-seam proof echoing 'red <path> on <host>', and the two scratch asks wait on the passfile fix
intention: test_proof_coverage.py is green on a box where its three teeth can be measured: test_NO_GREEN_SEAL_IN_THE_CORPUS_PARSES_TO_A_RED_TOOTH because no green seal's recorded output prints an indented 'red <path> on <host>' line (the host-seam proof echoes its inner command's output behind a non-letter prefix), and test_a_sealed_run_records_every_tooth_it_printed_not_just_the_tail and test_the_scratch_bus_goes_with_its_home because the scratch-HOME asks find the box's passfile (d95796cdfb9b and d66f2e18fc5c).
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akiendell, in the untouched house checkout and in a worktree alike: test_proof_coverage.py is 27/30 with the same three red teeth. (1) test_NO_GREEN_SEAL_IN_THE_CORPUS_PARSES_TO_A_RED_TOOTH reads the whole corpus of seals and finds cairn/devices/tester/validations/test_a_host_seam_seals_on_this_box_only.json: a GREEN seal whose stdout_tail holds the line '         red  /tmp/dfe6-host-seam-scratch.../host-testing-dfe6c1432fc8.json on akiendelllinux'. The proof prints its inner command's output with print('       ' + text...) (test_a_host_seam_seals_on_this_box_only.py:52), and proof_coverage's indented-label pattern reads 'red <sentence>' as a red tooth. It is a corpus tooth, so it reds on every box, not only Windows. (2) and (3), test_a_sealed_run_records_every_tooth_it_printed_not_just_the_tail and test_the_scratch_bus_goes_with_its_home, fail with 'the scratch-HOME ask exited 1 ... OperationalError ... fe_sendauth: no password supplied': d95796cdfb9b made a scratch HOME the child's home on Windows, and the passfile fix (branch passfile-d95796cdfb9b @ 4b1c65ef9) is not on main; d66f2e18fc5c D3 (d66f-d3-on-d957 @ 791138d51) fixes the scratch bus's shutdown. No ticket named any of the three teeth except d66f2e18fc5c for test_the_scratch_bus_goes_with_its_home.
traces_to: Akien's rule of 2026-11-13: every red is fixed or ticketed and none is lost; 'pre-existing' excuses nothing (Law 9). Law 3 and Law 7.
how: Tooth (1) is the one thing to build: in test_a_host_seam_seals_on_this_box_only.py:52 print the echoed output with a prefix that is not a letter (for example '       | ') so no echoed line opens with a marker word, then reseal that proof on the Linux sealer (so its stdout_tail changes) and confirm the corpus tooth is green. Teeth (2) and (3) need no change here: they turn green when d95796cdfb9b's passfile fix and d66f2e18fc5c D3 land, and this ticket is closed only when a Windows run of test_proof_coverage.py reads 30/30. Add PROVES for this ticket mapping the three clauses to the three teeth.

clauses.claim: test_NO_GREEN_SEAL_IN_THE_CORPUS_PARSES_TO_A_RED_TOOTH is green: no green seal's stdout_tail parses to a red tooth, where cairn/devices/tester/validations/test_a_host_seam_seals_on_this_box_only.json did
test_a_sealed_run_records_every_tooth_it_printed_not_just_the_tail is green on Windows, where its scratch-HOME ask died with fe_sendauth
test_the_scratch_bus_goes_with_its_home is green on Windows in test_proof_coverage.py, where its scratch-HOME ask died with fe_sendauth

decisions.text: D1: the host-seam proof echoes its inner command's output behind a non-letter prefix, so no echoed line opens with a marker word; resealed on the Linux sealer.
D2: test_proof_coverage.py declares this ticket's three clauses (PROVES); teeth (2) and (3) are fixed by d95796cdfb9b and d66f2e18fc5c, and are measured here, not rebuilt.

out: cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proof_coverage.py (the reader is right: a printed 'red <name>' IS a red tooth)
the scratch passfile and bus-shutdown fixes themselves (d95796cdfb9b, d66f2e18fc5c)
